description: This file defines an asynchronous Python function `generate_shift_report` that generates a detailed production performance report for a manufacturing line over a specified time window. It interacts with a database using SQLAlchemy to fetch production run, events, and alert data, computes OEE metrics, and assembles a report object.

methods.name: ReportOut generate_shift_report( db: AsyncSession, *, line_id: int, shift_id: Optional[int], run_id: Optional[int], window_start: datetime, window_end: datetime, )
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a shift report including OEE metrics, alerts, and a summary for a specified line and time window.
